title: The DNS-over-QUIC (DoQ) server in hickory-server (hickory-dns) before 0.26.2 does not apply any timeout when reading a…
description: A vulnerability in the DNS-over-QUIC (DoQ) server component of hickory-server (hickory-dns) before version 0.26.2 allows remote unauthenticated clients to open a connection and keep a request stream open indefinitely. This occurs because the server does not apply any timeout when reading a request message from a QUIC stream, bypassing all configured timeouts. This can lead to resource exhaustion and denial of service on the affected server.
